priorities.summary: OS command injection in Dokploy's patch.readRepoDirectories tRPC procedure lets an authenticated organization member inject shell metacharacters into the user-controlled repoPath value and execute arbitrary commands as root in the Dokploy container — and via the mounted Docker socket, compromise the host. Fixed in Dokploy 0.29.13.

Pre-authentication path traversal plus unsafe file upload in the Check Point Management web service allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to upload files to arbitrary paths and execute arbitrary scripts or load an arbitrary Java class. Confirmed exploited as a zero-day in targeted attacks as early as July 23, 2026; patches released September 22 and added to CISA KEV.

Unauthenticated remote code execution in JetBrains TeamCity on-premises servers (patch released July 28). CISA warned on September 24, 2026 that ransomware groups are actively exploiting it, and it is listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

model.name: PrismML Bonsai 1-bit LLM (Snapdragon smart glasses)
model.summary: PrismML unveiled a 2B-parameter 1-bit version of its Bonsai LLM, showcased at Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit on Sept 24, that runs fully on-device on the Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 Platform for real-time vision-language queries in smart glasses. It advances PrismML's open-weight, on-device AI vision as an alternative to cloud-dependent proprietary models — though no shipping glasses using it have been announced yet.
